query: Patient: 45-year-old woman. Among female inpatients aged 40–50 with neutropenic fever, stratify admissions by medication complexity score (first 48 hours) into quartiles and report per quartile: patient count, mean/min/max score, mean LOS, mortality %, and 30-day readmission %.
final_sql: SELECT (CASE WHEN emar.medication_complexity_score > 0 AND emar.medication_complexity_score <= 10 THEN 'Low' WHEN emar.medication_complexity_score > 10 AND emar.medication_complexity_score <= 20 THEN 'Medium' WHEN emar.medication_complexity_score > 20 AND emar.medication_complexity_score <= 30 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Unknown' END) AS complexity_quartile, COUNT(DISTINCT ad.subject_id) AS patient_count, AVG(ad.length_of_stay) AS average_length_of_stay, SUM(CASE WHEN p.dod IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ad.subject_id), 0) AS mortality_rate, SUM(CASE WHEN ad.hadm_id IN (SELECT hadm_id FROM admissions WHERE subject_id = ad.subject_id AND (charttime - intime) <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ad.subject_id), 0) AS readmission_rate FROM admissions ad JOIN patients p ON ad.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN emar ON ad.hadm_id = emar.hadm_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 40 AND 50 AND emar.diagnosis_code = 'NEUROPENIC FEVER' GROUP BY complexity_quartile ORDER BY complexity_quartile NULLS LAST;
